Blood-thinning medications (e.g. aspirin, warfarin) and skin conditions like rosacea, eczema, and psoriasis make a person more susceptible to adverse reactions during a facial (bruising, swelling, irritation). Precautions: disclose meds/allergies to the esthetician, use gentle/hypoallergenic products, skip aggressive exfoliation and extractions, use cooling/anti-inflammatory ingredients, and defer chemical peels or microdermabrasion until stable. #facial-contraindications

A facial should be avoided during a severe sunburn: inflamed, sensitized skin reacts badly to steam, warm towels, exfoliants, and massage pressure. Wait until the burn fully heals; meanwhile use gentle care, hydration, and after-sun lotion, and see a professional if there is blistering or significant pain. #facial-contraindications #sunburn

Skip facials during an active cold sore (HSV-1) outbreak: the virus is highly contagious, facial trauma/massage can worsen the outbreak and spread it. Covering the sore with makeup is also discouraged (spreads virus, clogs pores, slows healing). Wait until fully healed; manage with topical or oral antivirals, hand hygiene, and separate towels/utensils; cold sores usually heal in 1-2 weeks. #facial-contraindications #cold-sore

A small band-aid in an area not being treated may be fine during a facial; a large one or one over a treatment area means rescheduling, since it blocks product application, hides the skin from assessment, and a covered wound risks infection or slowed healing. Advise telling the esthetician about any bandages or wounds beforehand. #facial-contraindications

DV-2024 (Diversity Visa) entry period: 12:00 pm EDT Wednesday, October 5, 2022 to 12:00 pm EST Tuesday, November 8, 2022. Late entries are not accepted. #dv-lottery

DV lottery rules: only one entry per person per registration period; the State Department detects duplicates and anyone with more than one entry is ineligible. Spouses may each submit one separate entry. #dv-lottery

DV entry family rules: legally married entrants must list their spouse (unless legally separated, or spouse is a U.S. citizen/LPR), and all living unmarried children under 21 must be listed. Parents and siblings cannot be dependents. Failing to list an eligible dependent makes the entrant ineligible. #dv-lottery

DV E-DV form must be completed and submitted online in one session within 60 minutes; it cannot be saved or finished later. Keep the confirmation number and email account used, and check status via Entrant Status Check at dvprogram.state.gov. #dv-lottery

DV entry spouse rule: legally married entrants must list their spouse unless legally separated by court order or the spouse is already a U.S. citizen/LPR. Failure to list an eligible spouse makes the entrant ineligible. #dv-lottery

DV entry children rule: list all living unmarried children under 21 (natural, step, adopted, or spouse's) even if they don't live with you or won't immigrate. Parents and siblings cannot be listed as dependents. Omitting an eligible child makes the entrant ineligible. #dv-lottery
